title: A large check-in gain is held, not placed, until the person answers (decision X4, confirm_review_1 item 4)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027, after pay on Fri 25 Dec. The bank holds 100,000 (30,000 of it Free to spend left), the e-wallet 5,000, the cash 10,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th starts the period; Free to spend is 60,000 a month. At the check-in on Fri 8 Jan at 20:00 the person types 101,000 for the bank, 280,000 for the e-wallet (the bank's figure typed in the wrong box) and 13,000 for the cash. Every amount is made up. The check-in asks whether the e-wallet's and the cash's figures are right; the person has not answered yet: the e-wallet's check is saved with no answer at all, the cash's as `gain: asked`. X4: a large gain is held, not placed in any place, until answered. Before X4 every gain went back to Free to spend: the headline was 309,000.
